scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names web,api "pnpm -r --parallel --if-present run dev" "pnpm run dev:api"
scripts.test: pnpm run test:ts && pnpm run test:python
scripts.lint: pnpm run lint:ts && pnpm run lint:python
scripts.lint:python: uv run --project backend_api ruff check --config backend_api/pyproject.toml backend_api
scripts.format: pnpm run format:ts && pnpm run format:python
scripts.format:python: uv run --project backend_api ruff format --config backend_api/pyproject.toml backend_api
scripts.format:check: pnpm run format:check:ts && pnpm run format:check:python
scripts.format:check:python: uv run --project backend_api ruff format --check --config backend_api/pyproject.toml backend_api
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:ts && pnpm run typecheck:python
scripts.typecheck:python: uv run --project backend_api mypy --config-file backend_api/pyproject.toml backend_api
